x: Last winter's Cross Country clearly provided a good background for 15yr old Glyn Tiernan who reduced his 800m p.b. to 2.03.6 this summer.

First year Youth, Clive Gardner ran a fast 23.6 200m while Glyn Tiernan, the same age, looked impressive in the middle distances. Youths field eventers, Julian Mole and Festos Ogwuda, were both over 12 metres in the triple jump - which is good jumping.

But pride of place must go to the Youths with Gavin Warr clocking a fine 23.1 in the 200m final and Glyn Tiernan breaking a 15 year old Championship Best Performance to win the Youths 1500m by a huge margin.

It's been a great track season for Glyn Tiernan. Not only did he win the Surrey Youths 1500m in a new Championship best performance of 4.05.3 (beating the 11 year old record held by our own Bill Curtin) but he eventually lowered the Club Youth 1500m record to 4.02.8.

LAURISTON PAARLAUF (30 Minutes): 1.D.Clarke (HW) + Glyn Tiernan (Bels) 6 miles 947 yds; 5.M.Slowikowski (HW) + P.O'Connor (Bels) 6m. 454 yds. 6.O.Foote (Bels) + S.Instone (Ran) 6m 387 yds. 7.C.Clarke (HW) + D.Clack (Bels) 6m 386 yds. 10.A.Horton (Bels) + M.
Steve Webster pulled off some fine runs, studies permitting! While exceptional quality performances were provided by Glyn Tiernan not least in the Southern.

Olly Foote started STAGE SEVEN and the second half of the race and ran a solid leg to hand to young Glyn Tiernan in 7th place. For STAGE EIGHT Glyn ran a blinder and gave promise of a rich talent with a fine 16.47.
